accepted_parent.scope: one aircraft with a mounted primary TEACH-LRU-01, one BASE-01 spare, explicit E01-SURP remove/replace task and local ItemRepair, three fixed scheduled missions, seed1, horizon36

schema_reference.use: Copy only the DamageType, MissionDamage and DamageItem table column schemas before replacing their rows; this is a pinned schema reference, not the behavioral parent.

manual_basis: Installed manual physical pp193,425-428,432-433: a primary item can be damaged once per mission; DamageItem.REPF overrides discard default for damaged items; DamageReplacement specifies damage-specific item replacement before fallbacks. The dictionary pins the nine DamageReplacement columns and keys. BASE-01 is an accepted WS station in the E01 parent.
source_delta: The E01 parent becomes a quiet control by setting System.FRT and Item.FRT to zero and changing ProblemDescription. The child adds BATTLE-HIT DamageType/MissionDamage with DAMP1, DamageItem for primary TEACH-LRU-01 with PROB1/REPF1, and explicit BASE-01 DamageReplacement SURPT0.5/SURPF1/TID E01-SURP, plus its description. Both arms preserve the E01 mounted item, one spare, ItemRepair, mission pattern, seed and horizon.

pre_run_hypotheses.control: The quiet E01 control should convert with zero errors and complete all three scheduled missions without ordinary failure, damage, replacement, item repair or stock draw.
pre_run_hypotheses.lru: The child should convert with zero errors, log at least one in-flight BATTLE-HIT on the primary LRU and a critical mission interruption, replace it from the BASE-01 spare through the explicit damage replacement path, send the removed repairable LRU through the local one-hour ItemRepair route, restore stock or readiness before a later scheduled mission, and avoid permanent aircraft attrition. Individual event times are not preaccepted.
pre_run_hypotheses.alternatives: Converter rejection, damage without an identified LRU consequence, no replacement or damaged-item repair, permanent loss, or no later aircraft availability are diagnostic only. A successful process exit alone is not acceptance.

acceptance_gates: Independent pre-run static review of frozen E01 lineage, exact delta, dictionary/manual basis and guarded runner
Two fresh serial session-0 SSH native runs under Global\SimloxIssue18NativeQueue preserving GUI PID13340
Exact 20/24 authored row-containing table roundtrips and zero converter errors with valid native event logs and reports
Positive item-identified BATTLE-HIT consequence with local spare issue, explicit replacement, repairable removed LRU, later availability, and 72-bin System/Stock/ResultSummary reconciliation
SHA-256 sealed raw evidence and independent read-only post-run replay
limits: The E01-to-control FRT changes suppress random failures and are not themselves a damage-only contrast; the control-to-child delta isolates the configured damage tables plus description.

One seed, one primary LRU and REPF1 with explicit DamageReplacement do not test REPF0/intermediate, multiple independent consequences, damage of an already failed item, general fallback priority, shortages, GUI visual behavior or cross-engine parity.
